description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rate of Exchange effective from 27.03.2017 to 02.04.2017
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically modifying how financial calculations are performed for import/export duties. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it involves statutory instruments and compliance requirements for customs operations.
